title: The Lord Will Not Forsake His People

questions.question: O Lord, God of vengeance, O God of vengeance, do what?
questions.explanation: Psalm 94:1 (ESV): "O Lord, God of vengeance, O God of vengeance, shine forth!"

questions.question: Rise up, O judge of the earth; repay to the proud what they what?
questions.explanation: Psalm 94:2 (ESV): "...repay to the proud what they deserve!"

questions.question: O Lord, how long shall the wicked, how long shall the wicked do what?
questions.explanation: Psalm 94:3 (ESV): "O Lord, how long shall the wicked, how long shall the wicked exult?"

questions.question: They pour out their arrogant words; all the evildoers do what?
They crush your people, O Lord, and afflict your what?
questions.explanation: Psalm 94:5 (ESV): "They crush your people, O Lord, and afflict your heritage."

questions.question: They kill the widow and the sojourner, and murder the what?
questions.explanation: Psalm 94:6 (ESV): "They kill the widow and the sojourner, and murder the fatherless;"

questions.question: And they say, "The Lord does not see; the God of Jacob does not what?"
questions.explanation: Psalm 94:7 (ESV): "...the God of Jacob does not perceive."

questions.question: Understand, O dullest of the people! Fools, when will you be what?
questions.explanation: Psalm 94:8 (ESV): "Fools, when will you be wise?"

questions.question: He who planted the ear, does he not hear? He who formed the eye, does he not what?
questions.explanation: Psalm 94:9 (ESV): "He who formed the eye, does he not see?"

questions.question: The Lord knows the thoughts of man, that they are but a what?
questions.explanation: Psalm 94:11 (ESV): "The Lord knows the thoughts of man, that they are but a breath."

questions.question: Blessed is the man whom you discipline, O Lord, and whom you teach out of your what?
questions.explanation: Psalm 94:12 (ESV): "...and whom you teach out of your law,"

questions.question: For the Lord will not forsake his people; he will not abandon his what?
questions.explanation: Psalm 94:14 (ESV): "...he will not abandon his heritage;"

questions.question: When the cares of my heart are many, your consolations do what to my soul?
Can wicked rulers be allied with you, those who frame injustice by what?
questions.explanation: Psalm 94:20 (ESV): "...those who frame injustice by statute?"

questions.question: But the Lord has become my stronghold, and my God the rock of my what?
questions.explanation: Psalm 94:22 (ESV): "...and my God the rock of my refuge."

key_verse_text: For the Lord will not forsake his people; he will not abandon his heritage;
